opening.argument: The presentation ties specific payments to stated mining returns and recruitment rewards. It says viewers pay $500 per share for “1000 days of mining,” and the slide describes daily payments from the share of total mining profits. It also links referral commissions to a new member buying a mining-pool share, while inviting interested viewers to contact the speaker or their referrer to join BitClub Network. These are not merely descriptions of cryptocurrency or mining: the offer solicits payment for shares, presents mining profits and Bitcoin commissions as returns, and rewards recruitment tied to further share purchases. Taken together, the payment solicitation, promised returns, and referral incentives establish the paid mining or node-return scheme at issue.
